cases.stimulus: Incomplete profile or journal; gRPC port may bind
cases.expect: NOT_SERVING; required RPC UNAVAILABLE; no ready event

cases.stimulus: Complete graph, adapters, journal and four projections
cases.expect: Check("") SERVING only after complete discovery; EGIA initialize succeeds

cases.stimulus: Graph robot and camera/base/manipulator nodes
cases.expect: Exact robot id/name and only admitted device/binding metadata

cases.stimulus: No admitted world/detection/ASR producer
cases.expect: No invented semantic resource; stable URI order

cases.stimulus: Complete admitted runtime
cases.expect: GetStatus robot_id and robot_name equal Discover, nonempty status/version 0.2.0/RFC3339 started_at; rediscovery passes

cases.stimulus: One primitive control edge to one target
cases.expect: Exactly matching canonical name, logical primitive/version/device and availability

cases.stimulus: Rust skill catalog unavailable
cases.expect: UNAVAILABLE; selected EGIA treats skill set as optional

cases.stimulus: An invalid candidate generation fails admission while an existing immutable listener serves; live health then degrades
cases.expect: Existing complete generation remains; live health degrades without changing binding identity; no half catalog or in-process graph swap

cases.stimulus: Unknown URI or declared cold producer
cases.expect: NOT_FOUND for unknown; UNAVAILABLE for cold; no fabricated Struct

cases.stimulus: Hardware sample older than one second
cases.expect: UNAVAILABLE; no stale product returned

cases.stimulus: Validated product changes on subscribed URI
cases.expect: URI-only ResourceChanged; client re-reads matching product

cases.stimulus: Broken watch, reconnect, slow watcher and cancellation
cases.expect: NOT_FOUND/UNAVAILABLE auto-recover by selected EGIA; RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED closes slow watcher and surfaces to caller; caller explicitly restarts watch plus read; cancellation releases subscription

cases.stimulus: One or two distinct healthy cached camera frames
cases.expect: vision.snapshot 1.0; exact camera/count; complete distinct JPEG, dimensions and times

cases.stimulus: Zero/three count, wrong robot/camera, stale or oversized frame
cases.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT/NOT_FOUND/UNAVAILABLE/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED as owner contract; no unbounded work

cases.stimulus: Valid exact capability and object arguments
cases.expect: One Dispatcher reservation and release; operation/ack identity match

cases.stimulus: Missing arguments, malformed ID, unknown capability or unsupported conversion
cases.expect: INVALID_ARGUMENT or NOT_FOUND before release; unsupported not advertised

cases.stimulus: Concurrent and restart replay of identical ID/signature
cases.expect: Same durable state; exactly one adapter release

cases.stimulus: Same ID with changed binding or arguments
cases.expect: ALREADY_EXISTS; no second release

cases.stimulus: Lost response after Releasing and runtime restart
cases.expect: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN retained; no automatic movement retry

cases.stimulus: Pending command, then terminal; disconnect and reconnect
cases.expect: Current then at most one terminal; GetOperation recovers same ID

cases.stimulus: Unknown ID or recovered terminal record
cases.expect: NOT_FOUND or canonical terminal ack with matching ID/primitive/version/status

cases.stimulus: Prepared, Releasing, terminal and non-cancellable commands
cases.expect: Command-targeted Dispatcher cancel; unknown may remain unknown; non-cancellable FAILED_PRECONDITION

cases.stimulus: Backend dies after serving; listener begins shutdown
cases.expect: NOT_SERVING before new write rejection; bounded streams close

cases.stimulus: Deadline, journal failure and request-ID-only correlation
cases.expect: DEADLINE_EXCEEDED/INTERNAL before release; uncertain after possible release; x-request-id never key

cases.stimulus: Legacy durable command record lacks primitive acknowledgement metadata
cases.expect: DATA_LOSS for exact ID and degraded journal recovery; no re-release or invented acknowledgement

cases.stimulus: motion.stop targets one admitted device; repeat when already stopped and replay ID after restart
cases.expect: Distinct journaled MotionStop request and Prepared/Releasing/Terminal record; only that device stops; terminal confirmation or unknown; already stopped succeeds without extra effect; no duplicate release

cases.stimulus: robot.stop on two active actuators with one confirmed stop failure
cases.expect: Distinct journaled RobotStop request with empty device ID; controlled fanout and bounded result.parts; FAILED when failure known, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN when unconfirmed; emergency latch stays clear

cases.stimulus: safety.estop with confirmed emergency path, lost response and duplicate ID
cases.expect: Distinct journaled SafetyEstop request with empty device ID; latch engaged and terminal confirmation required for success; unknown never auto-released; no reset path

cases.stimulus: Journal v2 hardware record and v3 robot-wide stop record across restart
cases.expect: Versioned tagged Hardware{node_path}/Robot{robot_id} target and signed OperationKind; no fake hardware path; immutable target/kind; uncertain estop latch retained without re-release; robot.stop never latches

cases.stimulus: robot.stop crashes after first of two snapshotted part stop calls; duplicate same ID after restart; overfull target registry
cases.expect: One journaled logical release with canonical immutable target snapshot and at most one call per part; recovered OUTCOME_UNKNOWN retains only confirmed part results, other parts unknown, and never calls either again under same ID; >64 parts prevents SERVING; bounded result.parts and reason bytes

cases.stimulus: Concurrent movement Submit while RobotStop is between durable Releasing and terminal fanout
cases.expect: Durable non-latching movement inhibit rejects movement before adapter release; stop remains available; no emergency latch; confirmed complete stop durably clears inhibit

cases.stimulus: RobotStop target snapshot/result serialization overflow detected before Releasing
cases.expect: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; zero stop adapter calls; no movement-inhibit transition; no forged partial result

cases.stimulus: RobotStop result serialization/write overflow after first stop call may have occurred
cases.expect: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and durable movement inhibit; only confirmed part results retained; same ID never replays any target

cases.stimulus: Restart after partial RobotStop fanout, then authorized new-ID RobotStop against old/current target union
cases.expect: Old ID remains query-only OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; health SERVING with GetStatus degraded and movement unavailable while inhibited; new ID confirms every old/current target and durably clears inhibit; estop latch unaffected

cases.stimulus: Deterministically pause movement after synced Releasing and before its adapter call; concurrently start RobotStop; repeat with ambiguous in-flight movement and restart
cases.expect: Dispatcher release barrier holds prior movement permit across physical call; RobotStop closes new permits and syncs inhibit, then cannot fan out or clear before prior movement drains or adapter fences old physical generation; ambiguous/crashed movement requires proven quiescence or fence, otherwise RobotStop OUTCOME_UNKNOWN with inhibit retained; safety.estop stays independently preemptive
